thread:
Tom (Support): Escalating a P1 from trial AceroHealth — embed generation failing for 3 tenants, blocking onboarding. Error rate ~65% over last 30m. High chance to churn if not fixed. @Priya can CS own the comms?
Priya (CS): Seen. Thanks @Tom. Can you paste the root cause and whether customers have workaround? I'll prep comms + urgency plan. We should offer a rollback or temp config change.
Tom (Support): Logs below — 502 from inference-gateway when hitting /v1/embeddings. Tried restart of service, cache flush, and routing to backup model; fallback failed. Sample log:
```ERROR inference-gateway: upstream returned 502 while requesting model redwood-embed-5-large, trace_id=abc123```
OpsBot: [alert] 3 incidents in last hour for customer: acerohealth.dev (trial), severity: high. Linked incident: INC-4567
Evan (Solutions): Quick idea: can we route these customers to quantized-embed-4 which has been stable? Cmd to update route: `rwctl route update --tenant acerohealth --model quantized-embed-4 --weight 1.0` Would add <5s config change. Risk: quality delta ~0.8%
Tom (Support): We tried routing to quantized-embed-4 earlier; gateway rejects due to model-compat mismatch. But we can try proxying via dedicated embed pool. Steps: `kubectl scale deployment/embed-pool-standby --replicas=2` then `rwctl route update --tenant acerohealth --model quantized-embed-4 --weight 1.0`
Priya (CS): Ok. I'll schedule a 15-min bridge with support + SRE in 10 min. @Lena FYI — recommend we send a short proactive note to customer acknowledging issue and ETA 60m for mitigation + follow-up call. Draft I'll post.
Lena (Acct Exec): Please include a goodwill credit offer for the trial delay. I'll own the post-incident customer messaging after CS sends initial note.
Tom (Support): Update: scaled standby pool, now seeing embed success rate rising to 85% for one tenant. Two tenants still failing with auth errors — looks like token mismatch. Sharing `curl` response: `{"error":"token_mismatch","code":401}`
Priya (CS): Good recovery. For comms: short email: 1) apology 2) immediate mitigation (we've routed you to standby pool) 3) next steps (postmortem + credits) 4) bridge invite. I'll paste draft here in channel.
Priya (CS): DRAFT:
"Hi <name>, we saw an incident impacting embedding during your trial window causing interruptions. We've applied an interim routing fix and expect service to be stable within 60 minutes. We're scheduling a follow-up call to review root cause and offer credit for the downtime. — Priya, CS"
Tom (Support): +1. Adding SRE to track auth tokens. @OpsBot please attach INC-4567 to this thread.
OpsBot: Attached INC-4567 to thread.
Priya (CS): Assigning owners: support/Tom (remediation), SRE/Evan (root cause), CS/Priya & Lena (communications + credits). We'll reconvene in 45m to confirm stability. If service not stable, escalate to Eng-runtime.
